headlines.title: Wall Street rallies after Democrats win Congress; data center stocks slide - Reuters
headlines.summary: BOOM — the Democratic sweep is the BIGGEST story of the week, full stop! Every sector gets repriced simultaneously: oil CRATERS on Iran de-escalation hopes, data center and AI infrastructure stocks SLIDE on fears of regulatory headwinds, renewables SURGE, banks brace for re-regulation, and the dollar drops hard. This is a complete portfolio reshuffling event touching SPY, USO, XLE, ICLN, XLF, and every Mag-7 name — the breadth of impact is ENORMOUS.

headlines.title: Oil tumbles 9% as investors eye possible end to Iran war after US midterm elections - Reuters
headlines.summary: A NINE PERCENT single-session CRASH in oil — that is not a typo, folks! Brent plunging below $100 on Iran ceasefire speculation ripples through every energy company, airline, shipping name, and inflation-sensitive bond on the planet. XLE gets HAMMERED while airlines and consumer discretionary catch a massive tailwind — this is a cross-asset EARTHQUAKE that moves USO, XLE, XLI, and Treasuries all at once.

headlines.title: Wall Street Girding for US Debt Ceiling Showdown in 2027
headlines.summary: Divided government is BACK, baby, and Wall Street strategists are already war-gaming the 2027 debt ceiling fight — and the bond market is listening! A potential default standoff between a Trump White House and a Democrat-controlled Congress could spike Treasury yields, crush risk assets, and send volatility screaming higher across TLT, SPY, and the entire credit complex. This is a slow-burn fuse that traders are pricing RIGHT NOW.
